Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, c As Range, i As Long, s As String, r As Variant
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    r = Empty
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 5
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 1
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 2
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "'123"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 3
        ws.Range("A1").NumberFormat = "@"
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "123"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 4
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "'1.5"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 5
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "'-7"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 6
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "'1E3"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 7
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "'$5"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 8
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "'12%"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 9
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "' 123"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 10
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "'1,234"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 11
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "'abc"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 12
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "'TRUE"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 13
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "'1/2/24"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 14
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "'1/2/2024"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 15
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "'Jan-24"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 16
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "'2-Jan"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 17
        ws.Range("A1").Formula = "=1/0"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 18
        ws.Range("A1").Formula = "=NA()"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 19
        ws.Range("A1").Value = CVErr(xlErrNA)
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 20
        ws.Range("A1").Formula = "=B1"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 21
        ws.Range("B1").Value = 2
        ws.Range("A1").Formula = "=B1"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 22
        ws.Range("A1").Formula = "=SUM(B1:B3)"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 23
        ws.Range("A1").Formula = "=1+1"
        ws.Range("A1").Locked = False
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 24
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 5
        ws.Range("A1").Locked = False
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 25
        ws.Range("A1:A3").Value = Application.Transpose(Array(1, 2, 3))
        ws.Range("B1").Formula = "=A1*2"
        ws.Range("B2").Formula = "=A2*3"
        ws.Range("B3").Formula = "=A3*2"
        Set c = ws.Range("B2")
    Case 26
        ws.Range("A1:A3").Value = Application.Transpose(Array(1, 2, 3))
        ws.Range("B1").Formula = "=A1*2"
        ws.Range("B2").Formula = "=A2*3"
        ws.Range("B3").Formula = "=A3*2"
        Set c = ws.Range("B1")
    Case 27
        ws.Range("A1:A3").Value = Application.Transpose(Array(1, 2, 3))
        ws.Range("A4").Formula = "=SUM(A1:A2)"
        Set c = ws.Range("A4")
    Case 28
        ws.Range("A1:A3").Value = Application.Transpose(Array(1, 2, 3))
        ws.Range("A4").Formula = "=SUM(A1:A3)"
        Set c = ws.Range("A4")
    Case 29
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "'123"
        ws.Range("A1").Errors(xlNumberAsText).Ignore = True
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\ignored.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 30
        ws.Range("A1:B2").Value = "'123"
        ws.Range("A1:B2").Errors(xlNumberAsText).Ignore = True
        Set c = ws.Range("B2")
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\ignored_area.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 31
        ws.Range("A1").Formula = "=1/0"
        ws.Range("A1").Errors(xlEvaluateToError).Ignore = True
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\ignored_error.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 32
        ws.Range("A1").Formula = "=1/0"
        ws.Range("A1").Errors(1).Ignore = True
        ws.Range("A1").Errors(7).Ignore = True
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\ignored_two.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 33
        ws.Range("A1").Formula = "=1/0"
        ws.Range("A1").Errors(1).Ignore = True
        ws.Range("A1").Errors(1).Ignore = False
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\ignored_back.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 34
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 5
        ws.Range("A1").Errors(3).Ignore = True
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\ignored_number.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 35
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "'123"
        ws.Range("C3").Errors(3).Ignore = True
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\ignored_elsewhere.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 36
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "'123"
        ws.Range("A1").Errors(3).Ignore = True
        ws.Range("A2").Errors(3).Ignore = True
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\ignored_neighbours.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 37
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "'123"
        ws.Range("A1,C1").Errors(3).Ignore = True
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\ignored_union.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 38
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "'123"
        ws.Range("A1").Errors(3).Ignore = True
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "'456"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 39
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "'123"
        ws.Range("A1").Errors(3).Ignore = True
        ws.Range("A1").ClearContents
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 40
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "'123"
        ws.Range("A1").Errors(3).Ignore = True
        ws.Range("A1").Clear
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 41
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "'123"
        r = ws.Range("A1:B2").Errors(3).Value
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 42
        ws.Range("B1").Value = "'123"
        r = ws.Range("A1:B2").Errors(3).Value
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 43
        r = ws.Range("A1").Errors(0).Value
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 44
        r = ws.Range("A1").Errors(11).Value
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 45
        r = TypeName(ws.Range("A1").Errors) & TypeName(ws.Range("A1").Errors(1)) & TypeName(ws.Range("A1").Errors(1).Parent) & TypeName(ws.Range("A1").Errors.Parent)
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 46
        r = ws.Range("A1").Errors.Item(3).Value
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 47
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "'123"
        ws.Range("A1").Errors(3).Ignore = "True"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 48
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "'123"
        ws.Range("A1").Errors(3).Ignore = 1
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 49
        ws.Range("A1").Formula = "=""123"""
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 50
        ws.Range("A1").Formula = "=A2+1"
        ws.Range("A2").Value = "'5"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 51
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "'123"
        ws.Protect
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 52
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "'00123"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 53
        ws.Range("A1").Formula = "=SQRT(-1)"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 54
        ws.Range("A1").Formula = "=1+""a"""
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 55
        ws.Range("A1").Formula = "=nosuchname"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 56
        ws.Range("A1").Formula = "=#REF!"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 57
        ws.Range("A1").Formula = "=IFERROR(1/0,1)"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 58
        ws.Range("A1").Formula = "=B1:B2 C3:C4"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 59
        ws.Range("B1").Value = 2
        ws.Range("A1").Formula = "=SUM(B1:B3)"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 60
        ws.Range("B1").Value = "x"
        ws.Range("A1").Formula = "=B1"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 61
        ws.Range("A1").Formula = "=Sheet2!B1"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 62
        ws.Range("A1").Formula = "=ROW(B1)"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 63
        ws.Range("A1").Formula = "=ISBLANK(B1)"
        Set c = ws.Range("A1")
    Case 64
        ws.Range("A1:A3").Value = Application.Transpose(Array(1, 2, 3))
        ws.Range("B1").Formula = "=A1*2"
        ws.Range("B2").Formula = "=A2*2"
        ws.Range("B3").Formula = "=A3*3"
        Set c = ws.Range("B3")
    Case 65
        ws.Range("A1:A4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array(1, 2, 3, 4))
        ws.Range("B1").Formula = "=A1*2"
        ws.Range("B2").Formula = "=A2*2"
        ws.Range("B3").Formula = "=A3*3"
        Set c = ws.Range("B3")
    Case 66
        ws.Range("A1:A3").Value = Application.Transpose(Array(1, 2, 3))
        ws.Range("B1").Formula = "=A1*3"
        ws.Range("B2").Formula = "=A2*2"
        ws.Range("B3").Formula = "=A3*2"
        Set c = ws.Range("B1")
    Case 67
        ws.Range("A1:C1").Value = Array(1, 2, 3)
        ws.Range("A2").Formula = "=A1*2"
        ws.Range("B2").Formula = "=B1*3"
        ws.Range("C2").Formula = "=C1*2"
        Set c = ws.Range("B2")
    Case 68
        ws.Range("A1:A3").Value = Application.Transpose(Array(1, 2, 3))
        ws.Range("B1").Formula = "=A1*2"
        ws.Range("B2").Value = 5
        ws.Range("B3").Formula = "=A3*2"
        Set c = ws.Range("B2")
    Case 69
        ws.Range("A1:A3").Value = Application.Transpose(Array(1, 2, 3))
        ws.Range("B1").Formula = "=A1*2"
        ws.Range("B2").Formula = "=A2*3"
        ws.Range("B3").Formula = "=A3*4"
        Set c = ws.Range("B2")
    Case 70
        ws.Range("A1:A4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array(1, 2, 3, 4))
        ws.Range("A5").Formula = "=SUM(A2:A4)"
        Set c = ws.Range("A5")
    Case 71
        ws.Range("A1:A3").Value = Application.Transpose(Array(1, 2, 3))
        ws.Range("A4").Formula = "=A1+A2"
        Set c = ws.Range("A4")
    Case 72
        ws.Range("A1:C1").Value = Array(1, 2, 3)
        ws.Range("D1").Formula = "=SUM(A1:B1)"
        Set c = ws.Range("D1")
    Case 73
        ws.Range("A1:A3").Value = Application.Transpose(Array(1, 2, 3))
        ws.Range("C1").Formula = "=SUM(A1:A2)"
        Set c = ws.Range("C1")
    Case 74
        ws.Range("A1:A2").Value = Application.Transpose(Array(1, 2))
        ws.Range("A3").Value = "x"
        ws.Range("A4").Formula = "=SUM(A1:A2)"
        Set c = ws.Range("A4")
    Case 75
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 0.5
        ws.Range("A1").NumberFormat = "0%"
        ws.Range("B1").Formula = "=A1"
        ws.Range("B1").NumberFormat = "General"
        Set c = ws.Range("B1")
    Case 76
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 0.5
        ws.Range("A1").NumberFormat = "0%"
        ws.Range("B1").Formula = "=A1*2"
        ws.Range("B1").NumberFormat = "0.00"
        Set c = ws.Range("B1")
    End Select
    For i = 1 To 10
        s = s & IIf(c.Errors(i).Value, "1", "0")
    Next
    s = s & " ignore="
    For i = 1 To 10
        s = s & IIf(c.Errors(i).Ignore, "1", "0")
    Next
    If Not IsEmpty(r) Then s = s & " r=" & CStr(r)
    Tried = s
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Options() As String
    Options = IIf(Application.ErrorCheckingOptions.BackgroundChecking, "1", "0") & IIf(Application.ErrorCheckingOptions.EvaluateToError, "1", "0") & IIf(Application.ErrorCheckingOptions.TextDate, "1", "0") & IIf(Application.ErrorCheckingOptions.NumberAsText, "1", "0") & IIf(Application.ErrorCheckingOptions.InconsistentFormula, "1", "0") & IIf(Application.ErrorCheckingOptions.OmittedCells, "1", "0") & IIf(Application.ErrorCheckingOptions.UnlockedFormulaCells, "1", "0") & IIf(Application.ErrorCheckingOptions.EmptyCellReferences, "1", "0") & IIf(Application.ErrorCheckingOptions.ListDataValidation, "1", "0") & IIf(Application.ErrorCheckingOptions.InconsistentTableFormula, "1", "0") & IIf(Application.ErrorCheckingOptions.MisleadingNumberFormats, "1", "0")
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String, ByVal first As Long, ByVal last As Long) As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = first To last
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
